messages:
lee: hi all — i'm Lee, joining infra team this week. setting up access for a Private deployment and need to understand: who owns VPC/subnet allocation vs who gives service credentials? also want to know the official escalation path for pages (infra vs eng-sre) and who signs off on Dedicated capacity/billing dashboards. any quick pointers? :wave:

onboard-bot: welcome @lee! Start here: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/network-and-access. For most new-hire infra requests use the infra-access Jira template.

casey: eng-infra handles VPC, subnets, VPN peering, route tables. ping @eng-infra or file infra-access with the "vpc-request" template. include project, region, CIDR needs. Example request snippet:

```
Project: vector-search
Env: private
Request: allocate-subnet
CIDR: 10.240.32.0/24
Owner: lee
```

ria: eng-sre owns runbooks, SLIs, and pager response. Pager rules (short):
- page eng-sre-oncall for service errors, high error rates, or increased latency.
- page infra-ops for cluster provisioning, capacity, and network outages.
If you're unsure, page eng-sre first — we'll escalate to infra if it's infra-rooted. Runbooks live at https://redwood.internal/runbooks.

tal: billing and Dedicated capacity approvals require cost-center approval + infra lead signoff. To get `billing-read` for dashboards use identity portal: https://id.redwood.internal -> request access -> include cost-center and approver. For Dedicated admin/provisioning, open a ticket and tag `infra-leads` and `finance-ops`.

ops-oncall: oncall rotation quick note: eng-sre primary weekdays 8am-6pm PT, nights/weekends rotate with infra-ops. For urgent pages use `/pager eng-sre-oncall <one-line>` or call the escalation number in the handbook. Non-urgent: open infra-access ticket and mark priority P2.

lee: got it — thanks. one more: who owns the DNS/ingress certs for private endpoints? and if i'm doing a canary, who do i cc so we don't accidentally hit prod?

casey: DNS + certs are managed by infra-dns. add `infra-dns` to the ticket. For canaries, cc `product-ops` and `security` depending on data sensitivity. We usually do a 10% canary window, monitor SLOs, then ramp.

ria: also add an eval prompt set and perf baseline to the ticket if it's a model rollout. Helps us detect regressions early.

lee: thanks everyone — i'll open the infra-access ticket with the templates and include cost-center + cc product-ops. appreciate the quick map :thumbsup:
